object.name: evi_overdrive_env
object.digest: Antialiased passive tanh-like input/output saturation with optional envelope follower
object.description: A memoryless nonlinear approximation with antiderivative and oversampled processing. Can handle high gain input and remains well antialiased. An optional envelope follower allows for dynamic saturation.

inlets.name: gain
inlets.digest: Apply gain to engage nonlinearity, applied post envelope detection and pre saturator.

outlets.name: buzzy-tanh(x)
outlets.digestauto: Out - antialiased for your audio not for Maths

outlets.name: linear
outlets.digest: If the @follow attribute is on, this outlet will output the automatic gain envelope used on the input to the saturation stage.

attributes.name: aa
attributes.description: The 'aa' ('Anti Aliasing') method used. 0=Adaa1, 1=Adaa1 2x oversampled, 2=Adaa1 4x oversampled, 3=Adaa2 (default), 4=Adaa2 2x oversampled, 5=Adaa2 4x oversampled. 0..5 does not necessarily mean increasing in quality, it really depends on your audio input material. Experimentation is encouraged.

attributes.name: follow
attributes.description: Engage an envelope follower on the input which dynamically controls gain into the saturation stage.

attributes.name: hfcompensate
attributes.description: The object provides a high frequency compensation 'decorelation' filter on its output for restoring the reduced high frequency response that can occur with this type of antialiasing, especially when utilising the oversampling options (as opposed to just using pure 'adaa'). Experiment with turning this on to improve high frequencies (default on).
